title: SELECT & SELECT DISTINCT
description: Master column selection, column aliases with AS, and deduplicating results with SELECT DISTINCT.

blocks.content:
To pick specific columns, list them after `SELECT`:

```sql
SELECT name, age FROM students;
```

Use `AS` to rename a column in output headers:

```sql
SELECT name AS student_name FROM students;
```

Use `SELECT DISTINCT` to return only unique values:

blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, city TEXT);

blocks.prompt: Find all unique `department` values from the `employees` table.
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT);
